source: Screened out of data/registers/barcelona-ail.json (Ajuntament de Barcelona, Arbres d'interes local, CC BY 4.0, 208 entries) during the deepening pass that produced data/research/barcelona-extra.json. Not rendered anywhere.
how_to_read: leads = trees that failed only on our evidence bar or on the count, and are the raw material if Barcelona grows further. blocked = trees that must never ship whatever happens later, each with its reason.

leads.name: Freixe de fulla estreta del Jardi Botanic Historic
leads.why_not: Count, not quality. This and the Acer below are the two remaining trees of the four the Catalan government declared monumental in April 2025, all four in the Sot de l'Estany ravine. We already publish the other two (bcn_005, bcn_006) and the city intro already tells the reader there are four. Adding both would put four of sixteen Barcelona entries inside one ravine behind one paid gate. Strong candidates the day the page can carry them, and the pair completes a claim the page already makes.
leads.register_notes: No planting year recorded. 29 m tall, girth 2.5 m, crown 15 m. Catalogued 2015.

leads.name: Fals platan del Jardi Botanic Historic
leads.why_not: Same as above: the fourth monumental tree of the Sot de l'Estany, held back on count rather than merit. Register gives no planting year ('Per determinar'), so it would ship flagged.
leads.register_notes: 30 m tall, girth 1.4 m, crown 12 m. Catalogued 2015.

leads.name: Camforer del Jardi Botanic Historic
leads.why_not: 1933, so 93 years, and a third entry inside the same paid garden. Ownership reads 'Privat' but that is the museum owning the land, not a closed gate, the same as bcn_006. Held on count and age, not access.
leads.register_notes: Sector de la Mediterrania. OSM node 4506730853 confirms the position.

leads.name: Robinia del parc de la Ciutadella
leads.why_not: A 4.3 m trunk perimeter, which is large for a black locust, but the register's age field reads '100 anys' rather than a year, so there is no date to verify and no second source was found. Catalogued only in 2024, so press coverage may follow.
leads.register_notes: 12 m tall, crown 9 m. Parterre between passeig Joaquim Renart and the Cascada.

leads.name: Platan del parc de la Ciutadella
leads.why_not: 3.6 m girth and a 24 m crown, the biggest plane in the park, but the register carries no planting year at all and no second source dates it.
leads.register_notes: Between the lake and the zoo fence. Catalogued 2021.

leads.name: Pitospor de la Ciutadella
leads.why_not: No planting year, no recorded height, and a 1.55 m girth on a species that is usually a shrub. Interesting as a curiosity, thin as a page.
leads.register_notes: In front of the Glorieta de la Transsexual Sonia. Catalogued 2017.

leads.name: Araucaria de la casa de la Misericordia
leads.why_not: 27 m tall in the same courtyard as bcn_010, but the register gives no planting year and no independent source was found. It would also be a second entry on one small Raval courtyard.

leads.name: Platan oriental de la Universitat
leads.why_not: 1933, so 93 years, on a square rather than in a garden. A true Platanus orientalis rather than the usual London plane hybrid is genuinely uncommon in Spanish cities and this is worth a second look when Barcelona next grows. Would extend the Raval walk east to Placa de la Universitat.
leads.register_notes: 18 m tall, girth 2 m, crown 17 m. Public.

leads.name: Alvocater de la placa de Can Bruixa
leads.why_not: An avocado tree 17 m tall in a Les Corts square is a good story, but 1945 makes it 81 years, under the bar, and its 0.8 m girth is slight. 465 m from bcn_007, so it would join that walk if the age bar ever softens.
leads.register_notes: Public. OSM node 4506776546 confirms the position.

leads.name: Lagunaria dels jardins del Teatre Grec
leads.why_not: 1923, 103 years, girth 2.4 m, crown 20 m, on public ground in the Teatre Grec gardens. Held only because Montjuic already carries two entries and this pass spent its budget on Ciutadella. A good first pick for the next Montjuic pass, together with the Erythrina below, which would make a real Montjuic walk instead of two trees behind one gate.

leads.name: Eritrina dels jardins del Teatre Grec
leads.why_not: 1923, girth 2.7 m, 20 m crown, public, and a species that flowers hard enough to carry a best_time. Same reason as the Lagunaria: saved for a Montjuic pass. Note the register's units field is empty for this entry, so check it is one tree and not a group before writing.
leads.register_notes: OSM node 4492857600 records the species as Erythrina lysistemon rather than falcata; resolve that before publishing.

leads.name: Huingan del carrer Joaquim Blume
leads.why_not: 1916, public, but a street tree with no second source found and little to say beyond the species.

leads.name: Taronger de Louisiana del carrer Maria Montessori
leads.why_not: 1948, 78 years. The same species as bcn_013 and younger; Barcelona does not need two Osage oranges.
leads.register_notes: Named in the same beteve.cat article as bcn_013.

leads.name: Castanyer bord de la placa Carles Buigas
leads.why_not: 1937, 89 years, under the bar.

leads.name: Ginjoler dels jardins Joan Maragall
leads.why_not: 1958, 68 years, well under the bar, and the Joan Maragall gardens open only at weekends.

leads.name: Ginkgo dels jardins de Mossen Cinto Verdaguer
leads.why_not: 1958, 68 years. Would carry an excellent autumn best_time if the age bar ever softened for a species this distinctive.

leads.name: Molle del jardi d'Aclimatacio and Eucaliptus tuart del jardi d'Aclimatacio
leads.why_not: Both dated 'Per determinar' in the register, both a short walk from bcn_005 and bcn_006. Two undated trees is not a walk.

leads.name: Llentiscle de l'Hort de l'Avi, Garrofer del carrer Maignon, Pebrer bord del carrer Maignon, Xiprer comu del carrer Betlem
leads.species: Pistacia lentiscus; Ceratonia siliqua; Schinus molle; Cupressus sempervirens
leads.why_not: All four sit within 450 m of the Park Guell pins and all four are dated 'Per determinar'. They are the obvious material for thickening the Gracia walk, and every one of them needs a date first.

leads.name: Ficus de Mysore del Santuari de Sant Josep de la Muntanya
leads.why_not: Undated in the register and access to the sanctuary grounds is unverified. Worth a proper look: it is sacred ground 424 m from the Park Guell cluster, and CLAUDE.md's own step 1 says that is exactly where the unlisted old trees are.

leads.name: Arbres de l'amor de la placa Joanic
leads.why_not: 1956, 70 years. A Judas tree's April flowering would make a strong best_time, and it is 330 m from bcn_001, but it is too young.

leads.name: The Pedralbes cluster: Jardins del Palau Reial de Pedralbes and Jardins de la Torre Girona
leads.species: Pinus pinea; Cedrus deodara; Tetraclinis articulata; Brachychiton populneus; Maclura pomifera; Pinus halepensis
leads.why_not: Not evaluated in this pass, and recorded here because it is the strongest untouched cluster in the city. Eight register entries lie inside 400 m of each other across the Palau Reial gardens, the Torre Girona gardens and the Pavellons Guell with Gaudi's dragon gate, all in one walk, 1.2 km west of bcn_007. A future pass should take this as a single unit rather than tree by tree, and must check the access of each: the Palau Reial gardens are public, Torre Girona sits on the UPC campus, and the Pavellons Guell keep visiting hours.
leads.register_notes: OSM nodes 4506752018, 4532330334, 4506742261, 4506743003, 4506753110 confirm several of these positions.

leads.name: The Vil-la Amelia and Sarria cluster
leads.species: Schinus molle; Phoenix canariensis; Platanus x acerifolia; Eucalyptus globulus
leads.why_not: Four register entries inside one public Sarria garden, 900 m from the Pedralbes cluster above. Not evaluated this pass. The eucalyptus and the plane are single-unit; the palms are a group and would need the collectible-point test.

leads.name: Lledoner de la Fundacio Munoz Ramonet
leads.why_not: Access unverified. The Munoz Ramonet gardens passed to the city and open to the public on a limited schedule; that needs confirming before this counts as publicly accessible. Undated in the candidate list.

leads.name: Figuera de la Facultat de Dret
leads.why_not: On the university law faculty grounds. The campus is open in practice but the register does not say so, and the entry is undated. Sits inside the Pedralbes cluster above, so resolve it with that pass.

blocked.name: Platans de les Rambles
blocked.reason: Non-collectible point: 273 registered trees along a kilometre of avenue. This exact entry was already published once as bcn_008 and removed on 2026-07-26 for failing the collectible-point test. It does not come back.

blocked.reason: Access-restricted: inside the Barcelona zoo enclosure. Register ownership reads Privat. A 145-year-old oak with a 2.7 m trunk, and unreachable without a zoo ticket, which is not what this site sends people to.
